extract: recursive URL extraction follows document links discovered in results

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com\"}", "{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"document_url_depth\":1,\"follow_document_urls\":true,\"respect_robots_txt\":false},\"mode\":\"document\"}}")
debugPrint(result.results())
debugPrint(result.results()[1].content())
```
